calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, cp.category, cp.subcategory, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, f.channel_code, s.store_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.category, l.subcategory, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) dl, SUM(l.net_amount) sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) ret,
 ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) rr, max(r.n) maxn, max(l.sale_date)
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE l.category='Garden' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH base AS (
    SELECT f.*, s.store_id, cp.subcategory, cp.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND cp.category='Garden' AND s.store_id<>999
)
SELECT 'total' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d1, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(etl_loaded_at) a, max(etl_loaded_at) b FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_status:'||coalesce(w.status,'none'), count(*), count(DISTINCT b.sales_line_id), 0, NULL, NULL
 FROM base b LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=b.receipt_id GROUP BY w.status
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900', count(*), 0,0,NULL,NULL FROM base WHERE store_id=900
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff', count(*), 0,0,NULL,NULL FROM base WHERE staff_purchase_flag
UNION ALL SELECT 'nonpos', count(*), 0,0,NULL,NULL FROM base WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0

calls.statement:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.*, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.sale_date, f.product_key fpk
  FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id)
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' OR f.sales_line_id IS NULL
)
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) dr, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ds,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan,
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net > net_amount + 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned > quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) overqty,
 sum(CASE WHEN return_date < sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 max(return_date - sale_date) maxlag, sum(CASE WHEN fpk<>product_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prodmismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN refund_net<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, max(return_date)
FROM r

SELECT count(*) all_lines, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store, sum(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_prod,
 sum(CASE WHEN cp.sku IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_cur, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zz, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Garden' AND cp.category<>'Garden' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) garden_then_moved,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.category<>'Garden' AND cp.category='Garden' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) other_now_garden,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.subcategory<>cp.subcategory THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subcat_changed
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND (p.category='Garden' OR cp.category='Garden')
